title: NFC Card, for KaChat-NFC
summary: An NFC Card page under KaChat: load the open source KaChat-NFC software onto a J3R180 Java Card and secure its admin keys, so KaChat can back up a seed phrase you already have to the card. A small helper on your Mac or Windows computer reaches the reader; on a Linux server the reader can plug into the server instead (experimental). The panel never asks for a PIN or seed.
